sourceDescription: A curated antique shop in Hillsborough, NJ specializing in early 20th-century furniture, estate jewelry, and vintage collectibles. Every piece is sourced from local estate sales and hand-selected. Located at 45 Amwell Rd, Hillsborough NJ, open Wed-Sun 11am-5pm. Wants a classic, refined, elegant feel — not rustic, not modern-minimal.
